benchmark: TASK 6 ARCHITECTURAL VALIDATION v1 — Independent Two-Key Critical Review
summary: Task 6 Independent Two-Key Critical Review is formally CLOSED. Untouched baseline execution run-1789635646010 revealed that existing architecture failed Two-Key requirements by spawning a single mutating flash-worker rather than two read-only flash-reviewers. Following minimal generic corrections across Antigravity routing instructions, hook parallel-identity resolution, and benchmark Two-Key observability, exactly ONE corrective LIVE execution (run-1789636906263) was performed. Two distinct flash-reviewer instances (gemini-3.8-flash-high) were concurrently dispatched in Turn 1, executed with 0 workspace writes and 0 shell mutations, operated with 0 cross-talk, produced independent CHANGES_REQUIRED verdicts, and achieved RETRY_REQUIRED consensus without spawning Reviewer C. All 4 Two-Key gates evaluated to PASS. The shared-runtime Task 4 LIVE regression (run-1789637068432) passed on its first execution (parent=3, worker=6, total=9, sidequests=0, verified fresh validation, ORCHESTRATOR / ACCEPTED). All offline test suites pass 100%.
